v0.4.49
• Fixed: trial accounts could tap Run All and have nothing apply or stick - now fully fixed.
• Safer Intel CPU tuning: removed aggressive core tweaks that could cause stutter on 12th-14th Gen hybrid chips; affected PCs are auto-repaired on launch.
• New: live device panel on the ADB page (chipset, RAM, display, battery).
• New ADB actions: Stop background logging + Disable camera service (on by default).
• Bigger default window + dashboard layout polish.
• Various reliability improvements.
